hero.title: Friday prayer at Al Muttaqin
hero.description: Khutbah is delivered in Japanese, Indonesian, or English depending on the week. Please arrive early, as space is limited.

etiquette.title: The etiquette of Friday
etiquette.description: Small sunnahs that make Jumuah complete.

1.title: Arrive early
1.body: Come before the khutbah begins and fill the front rows first.

2.title: Ghusl and clean clothes
2.body: Bathe, wear your best clean clothes, and use fragrance if you can.

3.title: Read Surah Al-Kahf
3.body: Recite Surah Al-Kahf on Thursday night or during Friday.

4.title: Send salawat
4.body: Increase salawat upon the Prophet, peace be upon him, throughout the day.

5.title: Listen in silence
5.body: Once the khutbah begins, listen attentively and put your phone on silent.

parking.title: Parking is limited
parking.body: Please come by train or on foot where possible, and do not block neighbours' driveways.

women.title: Women's area
women.body: A separate prayer area for women is available, with its own entrance.

shoes.title: Shoes
shoes.body: Place shoes neatly on the racks at the entrance so the corridor stays clear.

children.title: Children
children.body: Children are welcome. Please keep them close so the khutbah can be heard by all.

ics.title: Add prayer times to your calendar
ics.body: Download the 30-day prayer schedule as an ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
